notes.title: A new game is finally here!
notes.content:
Finally! After a long time (I know), the remake of Conundrum is here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2907800/The_Conundrum_Helix?snr=1_7_15__13]The Conundrum Helix

The Conundrum: Helix is the remake of Conundrum. And for all people who are a little disappointed, don’t worry, it’s not just a rework of the graphics. You’ll find way more content and improvements, but if you know the first game, I can’t tell very much here!

I also want to apologize for the long time without news. I had a lot of work, school, etc., life. Also, working on this is quite a challenge, working with a small team, managing people is sometimes quite hard, but I’ll tell more in a future dev log.

So thank you for your wait, and I hope you'll like the game when it releases!

notes.title: IMPORTANT MESSAGE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218133/e01bba47e2876e2d4228a8bdcc48d0104db4def7.png[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT MESSAGE[/b]

Hi everyone, Nogam here.
A few months ago I told you about a CONUNDRUM update. In the meantime, a lot of things which promise to be interesting have happened.

I started to work on the update right aFter Its aNnouncement, And had made quite a Lot of progress on it, whEn suDdenly... poof... I lost all of Conundrum's data. AfTer that, I thOught a lot about the game aNd on how I could improve it. A lot of new ideas came up, although really far from the original idea of the game's render...

[b]A NEW GAME[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2018370/Ultimate_Cartridge_Collection_Deluxe/
This is why I decided to make a whole new game, where most of the concepts and mechanics contained in it will be previous ideas I had for Conundrum or for a potential second opus.
There will also be a few other features to make this project unique.

But what about Conundrum? From the feedback I received, I noticed that people liked the game. But the sound design and the somewhat simplistic graphics gave a very neophyte feel to it. I won't communicate anything about it yet, but new Conundrum related stuff might be released in the future. I will keep you informed of course.

Thanks for reading, NOGAM.

notes.title: Conundrum V1.0.1 [QOL #1] VSync, head movement, music...
notes.content:
Hey it's Nogam. And here's the first qualify of life update :

-VSync can be disabled
-Motion blur can be disabled
-Head movement can be disabled
-Music in the main menu
-Bug fix

notes.title: And now...
notes.content:
Hi it's Nogam. Conundrum just released and it seems that he found the audiance I was aiming for.
But the game will not stay in its current state. Indeed, in addition to bug fixes, free content will be coming soon.

[b]In the next days[/b]
An update fixing some bugs and texture issues. But also adding more feedback on some mechanics and quality of life.

[b]In the next few weeks[/b]
And now the interesting announcement, a free update adding more content. About 30 minutes of extra gameplay is planned, with new mechanics, more lore and new easter eggs.

I hope you'll enjoy this update.
